Metadata.Name: Shuttle Hawk
Metadata.Description: Hawk Shuttle a versatile space plane platform with partially reusable launch vehicle and ability to support a wide range of modifications from low kerbin missions to interplanetary travel with variety of comanifested payloads and the ability of long duration travel docked to an interplanetary ship
